llm_sql.raw:
WITH conflict_minutes AS (
    SELECT SUM(t_min - start) AS total_conflict_minutes
    FROM (
        SELECT tp.order_id, tp.day, tp.seq, tp.t_min, nz.active_from_min AS start, nz.active_to_min AS end
        FROM trajectory_points tp
        JOIN no_fly_zones nz ON ST_Contains(ST_GeomFromText('POINT(' || nz.lon || ' ' || nz.lat || ')'), tp.geom)
        WHERE tp.seq = 0 AND nz.active_from_min <= tp.t_min AND tp.t_min < nz.active_to_min
    ) sub
    WHERE sub.seq = 0
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_conflict_minutes), 0) AS total_conflict_minutes
FROM conflict_minutes;
